gloss: to bring close together; to reconcile; to align

definitions.gloss: to bring close together; to press together
definitions.explanation: To physically bring two things close together so they touch or are side by side.

definitions.gloss: to reconcile; to align; to bring into agreement
definitions.explanation: To bring differing opinions, positions, or numbers into alignment. Commonly used in business and negotiations to describe the process of reconciling differences.

examples.english: A child snuggling their cheek close and acting affectionately.

examples.english: I rubbed my hands together to warm them.

notes:
Combines {擦|す}る (to rub) and ⟦{寄|よ}せる→寄せる：02329_yoseru⟧ (to bring near). The physical sense of rubbing or pressing close extends to a figurative meaning of reconciling or aligning differences. Also written with the kanji {摺|す}り{寄|よ}せる.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擦|す}り{寄|よ}せる: to press one's body close
- ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擦|す}り{寄|よ}せる: to reconcile opinions
- ⟦{数字|すうじ}→数字：03361_suuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擦|す}り{寄|よ}せる: to reconcile figures
- ⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擦|す}り{寄|よ}せる: to bring positions into alignment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {擦|す}り{寄|よ}る: to sidle up to — intransitive version; the subject moves close, rather than bringing things together
- ⟦{歩|あゆ}み{寄|よ}る→歩み寄る：13197_ayumiyoru⟧: to compromise, to meet halfway — emphasizes mutual concession
- すり{合|あ}わせる: to coordinate, to compare and adjust — used for schedules, documents, and detailed alignment
